why: A dictionary of primitives is a cell of insertion-ordered keys, a map and whether its prototype is Object.prototype. put writes another key (unproved, WITNESS); both writes the same entries in the other order, a different key order (unproved, WITNESS: lane B sees the order); store writes through a name (proved); readBack reads the key it has written through a name, the same JavaScript, but for the key "__proto__" an ordinary object ignores the write and the read is Object.prototype, which the model does not hold, so the lemma does not close (unproved); has binds the in test to a name, in reading Object.prototype's keys through the prototype bit (proved).
